start: A workout open, a rest running, phone locked in a pocket

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end
user_sees: 'Rest is over' with the chosen rest sound and a buzz, shown on the lock screen, text 'Next: <exercise, set>' (or 'Time for your next set'), button 'Complete set'

steps.action: Do nothing for 2 minutes
user_sees: The alert goes by itself; the live workout card comes back
must_not: The alert staying until swiped and keeping the live card away

start: A rest running with MettleUp on screen

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end
user_sees: A softer 'Rest is over' at notification volume, gone after 60 s
must_not: An alarm-volume ring while the member is looking at the app

start: Do Not Disturb on, 'Ring through Do Not Disturb' on in MettleUp

steps.action: Let a rest end
user_sees: 'Rest is over' rings through Do Not Disturb on its own channel
must_not: Silence because Do Not Disturb is on
Ringing through DND when the switch is off

steps.action: Tap 'Skip' before the end
user_sees: No 'Rest is over' at the old end time
must_not: A ghost 'Rest is over' for a skipped rest

steps.action: Start a rest, tap '+15 s', wait for the original end
user_sees: No alert at the original end; it comes 15 s later
must_not: An alert at the old end and another at the new end

steps.action: Swipe it away
user_sees: It goes; the live workout card comes back

steps.action: Tick the next set so a new rest starts while an old alert is still up
user_sees: The old 'Rest is over' goes when the new rest starts
must_not: An old 'Rest is over' left beside the new rest card

start: Phone asleep, 'Alarms & reminders' not allowed, alarm delivered late

steps.action: Wait for a late alarm
user_sees: 'Rest is over' with 'Ended N min ago · Next: ...'
must_not: No alert because it is late

start: A rest ends with the phone locked on a gym bench

steps.action: Look at and listen to the phone
user_sees: The alert and next set on the lock screen; 'Workout sounds' off means it only buzzes
must_not: A sound when the member turned workout sounds off
Any detail beyond the next exercise and set

must_not: Old saved data missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Do step 1 of ""Rest is over" alert" on the phone with the watch connected; look at both. Then do it from the watch.

note: The watch app must buzz exactly once (it excludes the phone's 'rest-over' copy)

must_not: Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the saved data saved with its text cut without a word to the user
